title: Databricks URI detection: bare 'databricks' is an exact-string match, and every other form goes through urlparse scheme
answers: Why does is_databricks_uri return False for a capitalized bare 'Databricks' but True for 'DATABRICKS://PROFILE'?
Which tracking URI forms count as Databricks URIs (databricks, databricks:profile, databricks://scope:prefix)?
Where is the check that decides whether a tracking or registry URI points at Databricks?
Why does is_databricks_uri skip urlparse for the plain 'databricks' string?
body:
Path: Classification of a tracking/registry URI string as a Databricks URI in `mlflow/utils/uri.py:is_databricks_uri`. It receives the raw URI a user passes (default profile `databricks`, profile `databricks://profile`, secret-scope form `databricks://scope:prefix`, or other schemes such as `http://`, `mlruns`, `sqlite:///`).
Rule: The function checks `uri == "databricks"` first as an exact string match, and only then calls `urllib.parse.urlparse(uri).scheme == "databricks"`. The fast path exists so the common bare literal avoids the parser; behavior is otherwise parser-defined. Because the bare check is exact, a bare `Databricks` (no colon) returns False, while `DATABRICKS://PROFILE` returns True since urlparse lowercases the scheme. Keep any optimization of this function inside that same split. Coverage lives in `tests/utils/test_uri.py:test_is_databricks_uri`, parametrized over these forms.
Constraints: Covers only the scheme/literal classification; it does not validate the profile or secret-scope part after `databricks://`. Non-Databricks forms (`mlruns`, `http://whatever`, `sqlite:////tmp/mlflow.db`) must stay False.
Applies: Changes to how MLflow recognizes Databricks URIs from a user-supplied string.
applies: Any edit to the Databricks-URI string classifier in mlflow/utils/uri.py; not for downstream code that consumes the result.
says: Setting tracking location to capitalized Databricks without a protocol prefix is not recognized.
Tracking server address fails to connect when typing Databricks with a capital letter.
Support case-insensitive detection when entering the default workspace name as tracking destination.
Entering Databricks as the model registry address is rejected unless written in lowercase.
Recognize uppercase tracking server addresses when using full workspace connection strings.
